sentences.text:
Marupalli Vamsheedhar Reddy, vs The Superintendent Of
Engineer, on 11 December, 2024
Author: Nagesh Bheemapaka

Bench: Nagesh Bheemapaka
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Nagesh Bheemapaka
 Writ Petition No.863 of 2013
Order:

This writ petition is filed seeking following relief:
"to issue an appropriate writ or order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in demolishing and acquiring the properties of the petitioners viz H.No.23-6-77/12, with an appurtenant land of 300 sq.yds belongs to the petitioner No.1 and 2 H.No.23-6-77/13 with an appurtenant land of 155 sq.yds belonging to the 3rd petitioner H.No.23-6-77/5 with an appurtenant land of 284 sq.yds belonging to the 4th petitioner, open land admeasuring 1350 sq. yds in Sy.No.27/B and 28/B belongs to the 5th petitioner, open land admeasuring Ac.O.12 gts of the land in Sy.No.27/E belonging to the 6th petitioner and H.No.23-6-75/B admeasuring 210 sq.yds belonging to the 7th petitioner, situated at Shayampet Jagir, Hunter Road, Hanamkonda Mandal,
Waragal District, for the purpose of widening of the existing 50 feet wide Hunter Road to 100 feet and also for the purpose of implementation of the master plan road without initiating the proceedings under Land Acquisition Act and without paying compensation for the aforesaid properties as illegal, arbitrary and violative of Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and pass..."

2. When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for petitioners submits that in view of the interim order granted by this Court on 09.01.2013, no further orders are required in the Writ Petition.
3. Recording the said submission, the Writ Petition is closed.
Miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.

NAGESH BHEEMAPAKA, J Dated 11.12.2024 ds Marupalli Vamsheedhar Reddy, vs The Superintendent Of Engineer, on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196136888/
